card_sentences: SAMPLE Two friends in Queens started baking lentil crisps in a shared kitchen in 2023. They wanted a salty snack with ingredients you can read out loud.
allergen_line_verbatim: SAMPLE Ingredients: lentil flour, rice flour, sunflower oil, sea salt, whey (milk), nutritional yeast, onion powder, garlic powder, sesame seeds, soy lecithin, rosemary extract, tapioca starch, cane sugar, yeast extract, paprika, black pepper, citric acid, wheat flour.
may_contain_verbatim: SAMPLE Made in a facility that also processes peanuts and tree nuts.
